## Purpose
Houses the `git pre-push` hook that auto-refreshes docgen READMEs after every user push, plus its end-to-end test suite. This is the entire push-time refresh subsystem — the hook itself, not its installer (which lives one directory up).

## Files
- `pre-push` — bash hook installed (via shim) at `.git/hooks/pre-push`. On user push: forks a detached background worker (`setsid -f` or `nohup`), waits 5s for the foreground push to settle, computes a `--scope` from `git diff` of the actual pushed range (parsed from pre-push stdin: `remote_sha..HEAD`), runs `docgen --until-done --parallel 4 --scope <dirs>`, commits any `README.md` / `.docgen/state.json` deltas with `--no-verify`, and pushes back with `DOCGEN_HOOK_SKIP=1` set. If the direct push fails (branch merged + deleted), branches off as `docgen/refresh-<ts>` and opens a follow-up PR via `gh`. Carries the `DOCGEN_PRE_PUSH_HOOK_v1` marker so `install-push-hook.sh` can recognize its own. Locates the `docgen` binary via `$DOCGEN_BIN`, then `$PATH`, then `$BASH_SOURCE/../docgen` (vendored sibling).
- `pre-push.test.mjs` — node:test E2E suite. Builds a fully isolated env per test (tmp bare remote + working clone + vendored copy of this repo into `tools/claude-code-auto-documentation/` + a stub `claude` binary on PATH that emits a canned README), runs the REAL installer, performs a real `git push`, and asserts on remote state. Covers the `DOCGEN_HOOK_SKIP=1` loop guard (sub-50ms noop, no second push lands) and the cold-push path (detached worker eventually pushes a doc-refresh commit back to `main`). Exports helpers `setup`/`teardown`/`gitPush`/`waitUntil`/`remoteSha`.

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `../docgen` — the binary invoked by the background worker; located via `$BASH_SOURCE/../docgen` fallback.
- `../install-push-hook.sh` — drops the shim at `.git/hooks/pre-push` that exec's `pre-push` here; the test suite invokes it directly to exercise the real install path.
- `git` (pre-push stdin protocol, `@{push}` upstream tracking), `gh` CLI (only for the follow-up-PR fallback path), `setsid`/`nohup` for detaching.
- Loop-guard contract: any process that pushes on behalf of the hook MUST set `DOCGEN_HOOK_SKIP=1`; the hook's own back-push does this.

## Gotchas
- The hook **always exits 0** in the foreground — failures during the background refresh go to `/tmp/docgen-push-hook.log` (overridable via `DOCGEN_HOOK_LOG_FILE`) and never block the user's push. To debug, `tail -F` the log.
- The detached worker re-execs THIS SAME script with `DOCGEN_HOOK_REFRESH_NOW=1`; the top half of the file is the foreground hook, the bottom half (after the self-call guard) is the background worker. Edits must respect that split.
- Diff-range resolution tries three sources in order: the exact `remote_sha..HEAD` parsed from pre-push stdin (most accurate, captures multi-commit pushes), then `@{push}..HEAD`, then `HEAD~1..HEAD` (lossy fallback). New-branch pushes have a 40-zero remote sha and fall through to the next range.
- Test suite overrides `core.hooksPath` to `.git/hooks` per-clone so a user's global hooks config doesn't shadow the installed shim; without this, tests silently pass while exercising nothing.
